claims: No. 7 seed NC State defeated No. 10 seed Tennessee 76-61
The game was in the 2026 NCAA Women's Basketball Tournament first round
The game was on March 20, 2026
The game was at Crisler Center in Ann Arbor, Michigan
Zamareya Jones scored a career-high 30 points for NC State
Zamareya Jones made 9-15 field goals
Zamareya Jones made 10-13 free throws
Talaysia Cooper scored 24 points for Tennessee
Talaysia Cooper had 6 rebounds
NC State led 26-19 after the first quarter
Khamil Pierre scored 16 points for NC State
Khamil Pierre had 12 rebounds for NC State
Tennessee played without Janiah Barker due to illness
Janiah Barker is Tennessee's leading scorer and rebounder
Tennessee finished with a 16-14 record
Tennessee lost their final eight games
This marked the third time in school history Tennessee was eliminated in the first round
NC State advances to face No. 2 seed Michigan in the second round
The NC State vs. Michigan second round matchup is a rematch of the season opener
NC State won the season opener against Michigan
